products.name: Anyword
products.note: Predictive performance AI copy; marketing optimization; data-driven; performance claims

profile_text.body:
Anyword is an AI content platform aimed at go-to-market teams, described by the company as built for organizations that care about performance and brand. The platform is designed to work alongside any AI model or application, layering A/B-tested data and brand context into the content generation process. The company claims its approach produces a 30% lift in business outcomes compared to baseline AI models, and states that content made with Anyword performs 76% better overall.

The core technical offering centers on performance prediction, which Anyword says can accurately determine which of two content variations will perform better given a specific audience, business goal, and channel. The company claims this prediction reaches 82% accuracy, compared to 52% for generic models such as GPT-5. Additional capabilities include a Content Intelligence feature that compares published content against Anyword's proprietary A/B-test dataset to surface improvement opportunities, persona generation, and APIs that expose performance prediction and retrieval-augmented generation functions to external applications. The platform is described as LLM-agnostic, with data isolation that prevents customer data from being used to train third-party models.

On the compliance and infrastructure side, the company states the platform adheres to SOC 2, ISO, GDPR, and HIPAA standards, and is built for 99.9% uptime with global availability and failover systems. The held facts record one tracked product under the Writing and Editing category, also named Anyword, with no litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings on record.
